title: Cartridge
description: Adds Cartridge from Made in Abyss (as well as the curse mechanism) to Minecraft.
body:
Adds Cartridge from Made in Abyss (as well as the curse mechanisms) to Minecraft.  
  
将《来自深渊》中臭名昭著（不）的弹药包（以及上升诅咒系统）加入Minecraft。

 

# Abyss and Curse

The player can create **Abyss** of level 1 to 6 using **Abyss Creation Tools**. If a player ascend within an Abyss, they will receive the corresponding **Curse**.

# Cartridge

One player can put another player into a **Cartridge** by the **Surgery Table**. The player in the Cartridge will help the equipper resist Curses until death.
